subject: english
question:
The given sentence is divided into three segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'no error' as your answer.

By next year, / they will have / build their new tower.
solution:
The correct answer is **"build their new tower".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• The sentence **"By next year, / they will have / build their new tower."** is segmented into three parts.
 
• The segment that contains a grammatical error is the second one, **"build their new tower".**
 
• The correct verb form to use after **"will have" **is the past participle form of the verb.
 
• In this case, the past participle form of the verb **"build" **is **"built". **
 
• Therefore, the sentence should instead read **"By next year, / they will have / *built__* their new tower."**
 
• Thus, the correct answer to this question is **option 2) "build their new tower".**
 
• The corrected sentence properly utilizes the future perfect tense, which is used to express a future action that will occur before some other action or time in the future.
